notes: JSON-compatible YAML keeps bootstrap validation runnable before PyYAML is installed.
Freeze this file before the first full AI run.
v1.1 adds ai/quality/eyes-closed (informational: not a hard exclusion, no bucket effect; feeds the group referee and future best-pick tiebreaks).

v1.2 (validated against 24k real decisions): low-resolution is no longer a hard exclusion (43% of tagged photos were approved — it was punishing era cameras, not bad photos); blurry description excludes artistic blur; duplicate-ish cut (fired once in 25k — burst grouping owns duplicates now); occasion tags added (wedding, birthday, holiday-celebration, concert, sports-event) to power albums and semantic search.

manual_tags.description: Explicitly admitted into the display pool.
Strong positive manual signal. Preferred by Pictaria Frame.
Hard manual exclusion. Beats every other tag.

system_review_tags.description: Needs human review before entering the display pool.

quality.description: Usable image, but not necessarily excellent.
The subject is ruined by motion blur or missed focus. Not artistic depth-of-field or background blur.
A clearly visible person has closed eyes or is mid-blink. Only when the face is large enough to judge confidently.
Degraded, pixelated, or artifacted beyond pleasant display. Not merely a photo from an older, lower-megapixel camera.

exclude.description: Screenshot, app screen, webpage capture, or phone UI.
Document, form, mail, ID, handwritten note, contract, paper, or similar.
Financial, account, banking, tax, or payment material.
Whiteboard, presentation board, planning board, or notes.
General exclusion due to poor display suitability.

scene.description: Mountains are a meaningful part of the image.
Beach, shoreline, sand, or coastal recreation.
Forest or dense trees are prominent.
Desert or arid landscape is prominent.
Snow or icy winter setting is prominent.
Lake, river, ocean, pool, or other water scene.
Sunset or sunrise is visually important.
Restaurant, cafe, bar, or dining venue.
Home interior or private residence setting.
Architecture is a major visual subject.
Well-known or famous landmark in the image.

subject.description: Food or prepared drinks are a major subject.
Artwork, sculpture, mural, or exhibit is a major subject.
Car or vehicle is a major subject.
Flowers or decorative plants are a major subject.
Sports equipment is visible and meaningful.

activity.description: Dining, meal, restaurant table, or shared food moment.
Travel context such as airport, landmark, luggage, trip scene, or tourism.
Road trip, scenic drive, car travel, or roadside stop.
Birthday celebration — cake, candles, gifts, party for someone.
Holiday celebration such as Christmas, Hanukkah, Thanksgiving, or New Year.
Concert, live music, theater, or stage performance.
Attending or playing an organized sports event or game.

people.description: At least one child appears present.

notes: Buckets classify the AI opinion for the review queue; human decisions are a separate axis.
Buckets are evaluated by ascending priority; the fallback bucket catches everything else.
This section is review policy only: changing it never invalidates prior enrichment runs.

buckets.label: Candidates
buckets.description: Frame-worthy with no exclusions. Most of these should be approved.

buckets.label: Should Review
buckets.description: Neither clearly good nor excluded: borderline scores, privacy uncertainty, weak signal.

buckets.label: Unlikely
buckets.description: Hard exclusions: screenshots, documents, blur, memes. Most of these should be rejected.
